name: glyph
gpu_evidence: docs/MINING.md:34 ("resource caps enforced during evaluation: <= 24 GiB VRAM"); README.md:8 and docs/VALIDATING.md:8 (eval runs in local Docker on an RTX 4090, nvidia-container-toolkit required)
